title: Store foundation: SQLite + sqlite-vec + FTS5 (cross-platform)
description: The unified store's chassis, milestone 1 of the Local Store Initiative (implements the Chapter 2 record, BOTSPY-047770). A new isolated src/store/ module: one SQLite file in WAL mode (an out-of-process writer can write while readers query; a Swift app can share the same file), versioned embedded DDL, and both query engines compiled in — the sqlite-vec crate builds sqlite-vec.c from source via cc (no prebuilt binaries, the same build path as rusqlite's bundled SQLite) and bundled SQLite ships FTS5. The walking-skeleton task proves both on every CI target (Linux x86/arm gnu, musl x86/arm via cross, macOS 14 arm, macOS 15 intel, Windows MSVC — green today, required to stay green) before anything is built on them. Spec first (04_store.feature, red), then the skeleton. No src/cli or src/adapters changes.
